purpose: Teach: 完売/手形/再販/増収/不問/別個/特産/海苔

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、商品をすぐ完売されたぞ
lines.en: Your father had products sell out immediately when the company started.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the memory. Measured pace. Gentle authority — not boasting, but bearing witness. Slight pause before speaking, as if retrieving something precious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは手形決済の信頼を築かれました
lines.en: Yes. He built trust through reliable payment practices.
lines.style: Respectful and earnest. Each phrase lands with quiet conviction. Calm breath — not rushed. Honoring the memory while staying composed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、絶版品の再販でファンを喜ばせたぞ
lines.en: He brought back discontinued items and delighted his customers.
lines.style: Warm nostalgia in the voice. Slow, deliberate delivery. The satisfaction of recalling something well-done. Slight smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは増収増益を続けられました
lines.en: Yes. He sustained year after year of growth and profit.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Not celebrating — documenting. Measured, even tone. The respect of someone looking back at consistency rather than spectacle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、応募者の経歴は不問とされたぞ
lines.en: He hired people based on their potential, not their résumé.
lines.style: Soft conviction. The words carry weight despite the quiet delivery. Slight pause after 'potential' — letting it settle. This mattered to him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新事業を別個の組織にされました
lines.en: Yes. He built that new direction as a separate organization.
lines.style: Clear and practical. Not flowery — just the fact. But beneath it: understanding of why this choice was wise. Composed, measured breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、地域特産品を全国に広められたぞ
lines.en: He took regional specialties and brought them to the whole country.
lines.style: Gentle admiration. Slow pace. The wonder of recalling ambition tempered with humility. Trailing slightly at the end, as if still marveling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは海苔事業から始められました
lines.en: Yes. It all began with the nori business.
lines.style: Final settling of a long account. Quiet, warm closure. Slow deliberate pace. The wisdom of someone who understands where roots matter. Breath calm and at rest.
